question: Should OpenClaw ship this Discord subagent-progress mode with seven operator settings and the proposed shared channel lifecycle contract?
rationale: This is a new bundled user capability and public configuration/API expansion rather than a repair to an established behavior contract, so code correctness alone cannot settle whether the permanent surface should exist.

options.title: Sponsor the opt-in feature
options.body: Approve the direction after both lifecycle races are fixed and exact-head Discord proof is supplied.

options.title: Narrow the public surface
options.body: Keep a smaller Discord-only behavior with fewer settings and less shared lifecycle contract growth.

options.title: Decline the feature
options.body: Close the PR if the lifecycle complexity and ongoing support cost are not justified by the optional UX improvement.

recommendation.title: Sponsor the opt-in feature
recommendation.body: Approve the direction after both lifecycle races are fixed and exact-head Discord proof is supplied.

likelyOwner.reason: The strongest current history signal spans both the Discord plugin boundary and the shared subagent registry and lifecycle surfaces.
